description: Strata (strata:*, vllm:*) serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on ryzen, with the llama.cpp fallback (llamacpp:*, scaled to 0) folded below and the R9700 companion GPU row.
title: LLM — ryzen

panels.title: Engine state
panels.description: What the engine is doing now: idle, reading (a prompt), generating, unloaded.

panels.title: Decode rate (live)
panels.description: tok/s over the last seconds (live.tok_s); 0 when not generating.

panels.title: Expert cache hit rate (last request)
panels.description: Share of routed experts the last request found in VRAM. Below ~85% the CPU misses dominate decode.

panels.title: Context used
panels.description: The running request's share of the 256K context.

panels.title: Generation throughput (tok/s)
panels.description: avg while generating = generated tokens / time spent generating (MTP drafts included). live = the engine's rolling rate, shown only while generating.

panels.title: Prompt reading throughput (tok/s)
panels.description: Prompt tokens actually read (looked up minus prompt-cache hits) per second spent reading.

panels.title: Token rate (tok/s, server-wide)
panels.description: Averaged over wall time, idle included.

panels.title: Engine busy (share of wall time)
panels.description: One request at a time, so 100% means smelt is waiting on it.

panels.title: Cache hit rates
panels.description: Expert cache: routed experts found in VRAM. Prompt cache: prompt tokens reused from the previous turn.

panels.title: MTP draft acceptance
panels.description: Share of the MTP draft layer's tokens the model kept.

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Includes reading the uncached part of the prompt.

panels.title: Requests & context
panels.description: context used is a 0-1 share of the 256K context.

panels.title: Host CPU & RAM
panels.description: ryzen as a whole. RAM is tight with Strata resident (~57GB); evicted expert or n-gram pages are read back from disk mid-request.

panels.title: Generation throughput (tok/s)
panels.description: Blue = rate-derived average over the rate interval (tokens_predicted_total / tokens_predicted_seconds_total). Yellow = the server's last-request gauge.

panels.title: Prompt / prefill throughput (tok/s)
panels.description: Blue = rate-derived average over the rate interval (prompt_tokens_total / prompt_seconds_total). Yellow = the server's last-request gauge.

panels.title: Token rate (tok/s, server-wide)
panels.description: Per-second token counts including idle gaps, so lower than the 'throughput while active' panels.

panels.title: Prompt cache hit ratio
panels.description: cached / (cached + processed) prompt tokens over the rate interval.

panels.title: Time per generated token (ms)
panels.description: 1000 * tokens_predicted_seconds_total / tokens_predicted_total over the rate interval. Inverse of decode throughput.

panels.title: Time per prompt token (ms)
panels.description: 1000 * prompt_seconds_total / prompt_tokens_total over the rate interval. Inverse of prefill throughput.

panels.title: Decode rate & max sequence length
panels.description: decode calls/s (left) and the largest prompt+generation length observed since the process started (right; resets on pod restart).

panels.title: Draft acceptance rate
panels.description: accepted / drafted tokens over the rate interval. No data unless a draft model is configured.

panels.title: GPU — Radeon AI PRO R9700 (ryzen, companion view)
GPU utilization
panels.description: From node-exporter's drm collector. GPU busy % and VRAM occupancy for the R9700 on ryzen (matched by unique_id, since cardN numbering can change). A VRAM drop with llama-cpp-ryzen loaded means the model was evicted to GTT.
